name: Baudin Equipamientos
description: Uruguayan online store for commercial refrigeration, gastronomy equipment and household appliances, shipping from El Pinar, Canelones to all of Uruguay.
description_es: Tienda online uruguaya de heladeras comerciales, equipos gastronómicos y electrodomésticos, con envíos a todo Uruguay desde El Pinar, Canelones.

ships_to.notes: Ships to all of Uruguay; free shipping from USD 100 of goods in Montevideo, Ciudad de la Costa, Pando and Colonia Nicolich; rest of the country by agency chosen by the buyer, freight paid on receipt.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Free pickup at the showroom and warehouse in El Pinar, Canelones; coordinate by WhatsApp.

search.notes: The search page loads, but results did not appear in the HTML; they probably render with JavaScript.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Prices shown in USD. Robots.txt has per-bot rules and disallows /api, /checkout and /carrito for all agents. Catalog is oriented to professional kitchens: commercial fridges, gastronomy equipment, appliances; no TV seen.

sources.supports: FAQ: shipping coverage, USD 100 free-shipping rule, agencies, pickup in El Pinar
Home page: categories (commercial fridges, appliances), USD prices, cart
